**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/27 (Sat) 13:26  
[USER] User is excited to try making their own gluten-free bread.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in making gluten-free bread and is looking for tips to make it fluffy and soft.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended a gluten-free bread recipe with the following ingredients: 2 cups gluten-free all-purpose flour blend, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp active dry yeast, 1/4 cup warm water, 3/4 cup warm milk (dairy or non-dairy), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, and 3 large eggs (room temperature).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided instructions for making gluten-free bread, including mixing yeast, sugar, and warm water, whisking flour and salt, combining wet and dry ingredients, transferring dough to a loaf pan, letting it rise, preheating the oven, and baking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested tips for achieving fluffy and soft gluten-free bread: mix ingredients thoroughly, allow dough to rest and rise, use eggs, preheat the oven, cover the loaf while rising, and let the bread cool completely before slicing.  
[USER] User thanked the assistant for the tips and asked if they could add extra ingredients like nuts or seeds to the recipe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that user can add extra ingredients like nuts or seeds and provided instructions on how to modify the recipe to include them.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested stirring in 1/4 to 1/2 cup of preferred nuts or seeds before combining wet and dry ingredients and sprinkling additional nuts or seeds on top of the dough before rising.  
[PREFERENCE] User decided to add sunflower seeds to the bread.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant expressed enthusiasm about the user's choice to add sunflower seeds and wished them well in making the gluten-free bread, offering further assistance if needed.
